Name: Better Jas Smile PORTAIT MOD COMPATIBLE
Author: Suppabagga
Description:
This mod updates Jas's character portrait to make her smile be less goofy-looking.

All I did was take the vanilla art and tweak it a bit, by no means am I claiming to be some kind of great artist nor am I claiming this art is mine, obviously the artwork is still pretty much entirely ConceredApe's work so all credit still goes to him. I just couldn't stand looking at that goofy smile and had to change it, Hope you like it!

Vanilla Art by ConcernedApe
As this mod only replaces the mouth section of her portrait this mod is compatible with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, and should also be compatible with basically any other portrait mods as long as they follow her vanilla look.

Check out my other mod → [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29239]Cute Halloween Costume for Jas[/url]

How to install:

Step 1: Go to common\Stardew Valley\Mods
Step 2: Drag & Drop BetterJasSmile.rar file into said folder
Step 3: Extract
Step4: PROFIT

Downloads.Description: Just download and extract to mods folder.
